subject: Re: Kickoff: LILA dense-feature service
body:
Lucia,

Staffing and compute, confirmed:

- Csilla Nassar 50% research lead; Freya Ruiz 40% on the flow/depth training-signal pipeline; Emeka Pinto 40% Torch Hub + serving path; Amara Okafor 30% eval infra.
- Compute: eval reproduction runs on titan-a100 best-effort (8 GPUs). For the retraining: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-01 — 512 accelerators — which covers the ViT-L/14 retraining sweep in one shot. I sized it from the release's training config; one week at 512 gives us the main run plus two seed replicas.

Note: Vulcan has scheduled maintenance 2026-06-22 to 06-24, which doesn't touch our week but rules out a late-June retry. So protect the June 1 slot — data pipeline must be frozen by May 22.

Bao
